title: An integrated approach of green chemistry and analytical quality-by-design for simultaneous estimation of drugs in a fixed-dose combination by a stability-indicating RP-HPLC method
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00829H, Paper
Open Access

Varsha Vishnupant Thorat, Sudhakar Maruti Alave, Vijay Arjun Bagul
The RP-HPLC analytical method has been developed and validated for the simultaneous quantification of chlorthalidone (CHL), amlodipine (AML) and telmisartan (TEL) in a combination drug formulation.
